name: Pumpkin Ridge Golf Club
architects: Robert E. (Bob) Cupp (Witch Hollow); Bob Cupp and John Fought (Ghost Creek); both opened 1992

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage (f=json) at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 498700-501050 / y 5050350-5052450, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release pumpkin_ridge-data, _ags_244124c3...tif)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage (f=json) at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release pumpkin_ridge-data, _ags_9e49efe7...tif)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM ImageServer, 1.0 m over the request box), exportImage JPEG downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release pumpkin_ridge-data, exportImage.jpg), placed by its request bbox and clipped to the world + 100 m by make_ortho.py

world.note: bbox of the one OSM course polygon for both courses (way 901988733, 1,489 x 1,254 m) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (151-152 m west/east, 141 m south/north)

layouts.name: Pumpkin Ridge Witch Hollow
layouts.scorecard_source: GolfPass course 14617 scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/14617-pumpkin-ridge-golf-club-witch-hollow-course/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat, third party, unverified against the club's own card. Every row adds up; men's ratings/slopes from the same page. Agrees with the GolfPass membership page and wiscogolfaddict.com (2015). The tee table prints White Plus as 6,272; its row adds to 6,248 (the row is used). Members' par 72 (the Korn Ferry Tour plays 71, 14th as a par 4). Only Blue is built (standing default)

layouts.name: Pumpkin Ridge Ghost Creek
layouts.scorecard_source: GolfPass course 14616 scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/14616-pumpkin-ridge-golf-club-ghost-creek-course/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat, third party, unverified against the club's own card. Every row adds up; hole19golf.com's Blue+ (metres) matches hole for hole. The tee table prints Blue Plus 6,599 and White Plus 6,132; the rows add to 6,523 and 6,137 (the rows are used). An older card (greenskeeper.org: Blue 6,451, another stroke index) is not used. Only Blue is built (standing default)

attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Scorecards: GolfPass (Pumpkin Ridge Golf Club, Witch Hollow and Ghost Creek)
notes: Two courses on one property share one world (COURSE_BUILD.md 3.5): every layout is exported as its own course (courses/<layout id>/) whose terrain, surface, height and overview files live in courses/pumpkin_ridge/. OSM maps one leisure=golf_course polygon for the club, so each hole line carries layout=<id> (edits.json, from the hole line's OSM name). Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-10-24: Blue tees; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed.

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar (2019 or earlier) predates the OSIP 2024 photo: lidar crowns that are not dark canopy on the photo are dropped (pipeline/gorse.py missing_in_ortho): a cleared plantation north of the course and about 180 crowns inside the boundary (Ghost Creek 11/12 and 16/17 native areas, checked on the photo 2026-10-24)

green_tilt.note: Ghost Creek 17 (with layouts s07 keys a green as 1000 x (layout position + 1) + hole: 2017). Its random bump on top of the 2.5 % tilt left the game only two hole locations (pins.test.ts wants three at <= 3 % round the cup); the bump is dropped, the tilt kept
